name: Low-Carb Ground Beef Stroganoff Skillet (Noodleless)
src_nutrition_note: Per serving, stroganoff alone. 4.6g net carbs alone; ~8g net carbs served over fried cabbage or cauliflower rice. Well inside band on every basis.
ingredients_verbatim: 1/4 cup onions, chopped or sliced (1 ounce)
1 tsp beef base (I like Better than Bouillon)
SERVE OVER (choose one): 12 oz cabbage, cut into thin strips then fried until tender
SERVE OVER (choose one): 12 oz cauliflower rice (raw weight), fried or steamed
unmapped: brandy (no board home - flavor deglaze, small qty)
beef base / Better than Bouillon paste (board tracks beef-broth, not bouillon paste)
why: Mid-band on the source's own numbers (466 cal) with 26.5g protein and only ~6g total carbs, and served over fried cabbage or cauliflower rice it still sits ~8g net carbs - deep in the low-carb zone with real headroom under both gates. Ground beef + mushrooms + onions + cream cheese + sour cream all map to the Omaha board; scales cleanly at 14 as a weigh-and-divide skillet. Distinct from existing ground-beef-stroganoff-pasta (that one is pasta-based; this is a noodleless skillet). Brandy is a genuine board gap - a useful pricer-lane test.
confidence: high - read full published nutrition and ingredient list from source page
